fixes.explanation: Yes, sow! "He who watches the wind will fail to sow…" (Ecclesiastes 11:4) Planting is the job, and watching the wind isn't planting. Sowing is the work that gets skipped. Meanwhile my dough has never risen from being stared at.

Rejoice, that's the word! "So if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all." (Ecclesiastes 11:8) The verse says them all, so no year gets skipped. I spent years in the back of a junk drawer, and I can tell you I'm rejoicing a whole lot more these days.
